claim_boundary: This boundary records backend control-plane readiness criteria tied to the bounded backend scheduling and critique matrix. It does not claim a backend-role capability matrix, critique-control checklist, calibrated reward policy, role quota ownership, live provider pricing/default evidence, raw provider replay, live hard cancellation, equal-budget scheduler comparator, first-class Gemini lane evidence, async reviewer isolation, stale-readiness detector, or owner review signoff.

readiness_criteria.control_plane_surface: backend roles, provider lanes, and scheduler eligibility
readiness_criteria.current_scope: nine ROADMAP backend/critique tracks with local sidecar and TODO links
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: backend-role capability matrix separating selection policy, provider support, quota ownership, replay, cancellation, and reviewer semantics

readiness_criteria.control_plane_surface: role-scoped scheduler rewards, budgets, quotas, and backend choice
readiness_criteria.current_scope: heuristic reward accounting and role-scoped budget maps
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: calibrated reward policy and explicit role quota ownership for each backend lane
readiness_criteria.validation_gate: calibrated reward and quota ownership policy

readiness_criteria.control_plane_surface: provider telemetry, pricing defaults, and replayable request/response evidence
readiness_criteria.current_scope: configured token-cost estimates and bounded scalar diagnostics
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: live provider pricing/default evidence plus raw provider replay policy
readiness_criteria.validation_gate: live pricing/default and raw replay evidence

readiness_criteria.control_plane_surface: provider timeout, hard cancellation, scheduler state, and resumed runs
readiness_criteria.current_scope: policy-only cancellation evidence and bounded pending-work resume surfaces
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: live hard cancellation artifacts and resume semantics that preserve scheduler/provider state
readiness_criteria.validation_gate: live cancellation and resumed scheduler trace evidence

readiness_criteria.control_plane_surface: fast/strong model mix, proposal budgets, and scheduler comparisons
readiness_criteria.current_scope: throughput/depth metadata, sample-efficiency boundaries, and no equal-budget comparator
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: equal-budget scheduler comparator proving backend policy effects separately from call caps

readiness_criteria.control_plane_surface: Gemini provider lane, substitution rules, and self-training loop claims
readiness_criteria.current_scope: Gemini absence/parity boundaries and no first-class Gemini lane evidence
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: first-class Gemini lane evidence and explicit Gemini substitution status
readiness_criteria.validation_gate: Gemini lane and substitution policy evidence

readiness_criteria.control_plane_surface: critique reviewer pools, reviewer overlap, and critique-to-revision attribution
readiness_criteria.current_scope: synchronous first/last-valid reviewer aggregation without async isolation
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: critique-control checklist and async reviewer isolation evidence
readiness_criteria.validation_gate: critique-control checklist and reviewer isolation report

readiness_criteria.control_plane_surface: README, papers, ROADMAP, generated inventories, and owner readiness claims
readiness_criteria.current_scope: bounded inventories and TODO ownership sidecars without owner signoff
readiness_criteria.missing_readiness: stale-readiness detector and owner signoff before backend-scheduler parity claims
